status: Evidence verdicts for review; not business approval

rows.verdict:
Supported: imports are material.
Sustained future volumes remain a forecast case; the matched balance is open.
rows.evidence:
Diesel drives imports; sales reports conflict
2024 net petrol/diesel imports: 13.078 bn L. Production, stocks, sales coverage and port allocation remain open.

rows.verdict:
Supported: concentrated demand.
Focus on Gauteng/KZN; sales totals do not establish accessible customers.
rows.evidence:
Demand sits around Vopak’s footprint
GP, KZN and WC account for 68.6% of 2022 sales. Historical volumes were broadly steady; later provinces are estimates.

rows.verdict:
Partly supported: diesel generation is falling.
Rail, EV and price effects remain unquantified; a uniform demand decline is unproven.
rows.evidence:
Diesel generation is falling; other drivers differ
Freight, EV uptake and prices follow different paths. Fuel used per km or unit of output is needed to quantify litres.

rows.verdict:
Supported: refining capacity fell.
Plant futures are conditional; capacity alone does not determine imports.
rows.evidence:
Supply change makes import needs conditional
Capacity has declined; redevelopment is conditional. Secunda/Natref product output and future cases remain open.

rows.verdict:
Open: gateway competition.
No route winner without comparable cost, service and customer access.
rows.evidence:
Alternative gateways challenge the same inland market
Matola and Walvis Bay have storage; their competitiveness depends on full costs, route capacity and access.

rows.verdict:
Open: Vopak share is unproven.
Tanks show footprint; unique deliveries and access establish served volumes.
rows.evidence:
Market share of Vopak in Dbn and Lesedi
Share is not established. Published tanks show footprint; unique customer deliveries establish served demand.

rows.verdict:
Conditional: win customers first.
Use existing assets; new storage needs secured flows and a usable-capacity gap.
rows.evidence:
Potential scope for new investment?
Prioritise Durban/Lesedi customer flows. Additional storage follows secured volumes and a usable-capacity gap.

appendices.18: Henry situation prompts: supports rows 1, 2, 3 and 4
appendices.19: Henry complication prompts: supports rows 3, 4 and 5
appendices.20: Henry resolution prompts: supports rows 6 and 7
